'''Maz-Verlin''' was the only [[City/Legends|city]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vernet]]. It contained the planet's only [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] and the main roadway known as [[Center Street]], and was surrounded by storage silos. Produce grown in the [[Farm/Legends|farms]] was transported to Maz-Verlin and kept in the silos until it was flown off-world. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] established a [[Vernet Imperial Army Training Camp|training camp]] outside Maz-Verlin and conscripted all able-bodied males.<ref name="TD" />
